seo.seo_description: How Norden Media UF handles the personal data you provide through our website, and what rights you have.

innehall.t2: How Norden Media UF handles the personal data you provide through our website.
innehall.t5: Norden Media UF is the controller of your personal data. You can reach us at
innehall.t8: When you use the contact form we store your name, company, email address, phone number (if you provide it), the services you are interested in and your message.
innehall.t10: We only use your details to reply to your request, book a call and, if you become a client, to fulfil our agreement. The legal basis is your consent and our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries.
innehall.t12: Enquiries that do not lead to an assignment are deleted no later than twelve months after we have handled them. Client data is kept for as long as the agreement lasts and thereafter as long as Swedish accounting law requires.
innehall.t14: We never sell your data. It may be processed by suppliers that help us run the website and receive form submissions, such as our web host and email provider. They may only use the data on our behalf.
innehall.t16: The website uses no tracking or marketing cookies. If you choose light or dark mode, your choice is stored locally in your browser so it is remembered next time.
innehall.t18: You have the right to know what data we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to object to the processing and to withdraw your consent. Contact us at
innehall.t18_2: . If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).
